transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess I'm here because the clinic doctor got on me about my eating. I mean, most days I just keep it simple. I usually just have coffee in the morning, maybe a few bites of something between painting jobs, and... a small dinner, if I'm not too busy with my class paperwork. It's just my normal routine, but they wanted me to come talk to you.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah, I suppose I am. It's just... if I eat something heavy, like pizza or a big sandwich, I get this really panicky feeling. I start worrying that I'll wake up bigger and slower. My work is physical, so I have to be up and down ladders and moving around rooms all day. I just get scared that if I put on weight, I won't be able to move around the way I need to for my job.
When you look at your body, do you feel like you are overweight?

Um, no, I wouldn't say I feel overweight. When I look in the mirror, I just... I see my normal body. I don't think I'm too big right now, I just want to make sure it stays that way. I guess I just check to make sure I haven't gained anything so I can keep working the way I do.
Has your weight dropped to a level that a doctor has told you is below what’s healthy for you?

Yeah, the doctor at the clinic did tell me it was below what's healthy. I mean, my work pants hang pretty loose on me now, and... well, people on the job sites keep saying I look too thin. But honestly, I don't really see it that way. I see it more like I've just leaned out from staying on my feet all day for work.
Do you believe you are too thin?

No, not really. I mean... I don't think my weight is some kind of emergency, even though everyone keeps acting like it is. To me, it just feels like they're making a really big deal out of me being disciplined and staying busy with my work. I just don't see it as a problem.
Are you deliberately eating less in order to keep from gaining weight?

Yeah, I am. If I eat something heavy, like pizza or a big sandwich, I just... I get this panicky feeling. I start worrying that I'll wake up bigger and slower. I have to be able to move around ladders and rooms the way I need to for my jobs, so... yeah, I definitely eat less on purpose to make sure I don't gain weight and lose my edge.
